fixture_categories.description: Correct small LaTeX paper with theorem, definition, proof, equation and explicit dependency.
Multi-file source, custom environment, supported macro and use/definition provenance.
Same notation in distinct scopes with shadowing and restoration.
Source-derived conjunctive premises and an explicit alternative derivation.

scenarios.description: Manuscript to accepted-under-policy claim via anchored scopes, source formalization, real isolated Lean/replay and current authenticated fidelity decisions.

Installed multi-file scope/citation/proof links, configured protocol/replay, real PDF and interpretation override update graphs/reports without source mutation or promotion.
Complete installed package/regression qualification across kernel/schema/trust/security/math/provider/store/revision/CLI/workflow/benchmark boundaries at unchanged coverage gates.
